notes.title: New update - Bug fixes, Balancing and QoL
notes.content: [p]Hello Steve,[/p][p]Here we are again with a minor update.[/p][p][/p][h2]Balancing[/h2][h3]Bike wheel[/h3][p]Bike wheel will now give 20 points instead of 50 points per combine.[/p][p][i]Comment from Steve: The Bike Wheel is at a sweet point size-wise, but it gave the road a bit too easy a point-wise. While keeping this aspect alive, this should prevent "Bike Wheel only runs".[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Remove from deck cost[/h3][p]Removing from the deck now costs 99 only in the round before the boss and not on round 12.[/p][p][i]Comment from Steve: The intention remains the same, but the last objective being difficult, allowing the player to remove it if they have not reached the objective, will block players less.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]New feature[/h2][h3]Ommetaphobia mode[/h3][p]An alternative eyeball skin can now be enabled in the settings.[/p][p][/p][h2]Quality of life[/h2][list][*][p]The "Create a deck" button has been added to the endgame screen[/p][/*][*][p]Malus sound will only be played once if multiple malus are created at once.[/p][/*][*][p]Donut tooltip detection zone is now a circle and not a donut.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Controller cursor is now above everything else, no matter what.[/p][/*][*][p]The ship and the next object are above UI, except for object tooltips[/p][/*][*][p]Pigeon eating heart will no longer keep the shop reduction active[/p][/*][*][p]Losing during the 5-second timer will no longer count as a win and no longer trigger achievement, stats and challenge win.[/p][/*][*][p]Playing a challenge and changing mode will no longer allow you to purchase a passive you already own or duplicate a passive[/p][/*][*][p]Demo has also been updated and should no longer have the "game crash" if you win your first game.[/p][/*][*][p]Music will now be played even if you restart the game quickly[/p][/*][*][p]Arena Rotation will be correctly reset if you restart the game with F5[/p][/*][*][p]Fonts will now be correctly changed if you switch saves.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Most of the minor bugs should now have been fixed.[/p][p]Have a great day,[/p][p]Steve[/p]

notes.title: Tiny Teams 2025 Update - Starting deck, Timer and more!
notes.content: [p]Hey Steve![/p][p]2 weeks ago, Steve's Warehouse was released to the world! We want to deeply thank everyone who played the game! If you liked it, don't hesitate to leave a positive review on Steam. This is one of the best ways to help us.[/p][p][/p][p]Starting [b]August 7[/b], we will be participating in the [b]Steam Event Tiny Teams 2025[/b]. We want to thank the team at Yogcast Games for selecting us, and for this occasion, we have prepared a new update:[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032435/69beccf3a4e43294d13620a8cb2fe46e99a3cfb2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]ːhappydonutː New content ːhappydonutː[/h1][h2]Create a starting deck[/h2][p]The feature that has been the most requested has arrived: [b]Starting deck creation![/b][/p][p]To unlock this feature, you'll need to have at least completed the tutorial.[/p][p]You can now select your starting deck for any arena (not supported for challenges). For that, you can select up to 4 common objects (1-cost)  and up to 1 rare object (3-cost). With the added constraint that you cannot start with more than 2 of the same object.[/p][p][i]Comment from Steve: I hope this feature will ensure more strategic planning even before the game and ease the discovery of all the families![/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032435/af7fbf7c94290855038b7308bdb6da1547a9283a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Speedrun Timer[/h2][p]A timer has been on the score recap.[/p][p]The timer will only appear when you win a run. The timer will display "New record" if you've gotten a faster time.[/p][p]Speedrun timer tracking has been started with this update and is not retroactive.[/p][p][i]Comment from Steve: Speedruns incoming?[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Steamdeck[/h2][p]We are glad to announce that Steve's Warehouse has been officially [b]Steam Deck verified[/b]![/p][h1][/h1][h2]Steam Community items[/h2][p]Community items have also been unlocked![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032435/d114f52105dbec33d20f40a59dfed35bbabb849f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Quality of life improvements[/h2][list][*][p]You can now press Space or LT/L2 to skip the [b]typist animation[/b] in the [b]Gold Recap page[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Gold, health, round, score objective, score and number of deleters have been added to the [b]Arena page[/b], allowing you to check them from the shop/passive shop.[/p][/*][*][p]All Left-side back arrows in pages have been replaced by a cross on the right-side.[/p][p][i]Comment from Steve: This change might perturb you at first, but once used to it, it will just be better, creating continuity in-game between the buttons on the right and the cross now also on the right. Allowing you to open/close pages more quickly[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Improved the Passive shop and Score recap text boxes to stop text from overlapping[/p][/*][*][p]Lebowski achievement wording has been changed to avoid confusion.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Balancing and fixes[/h2][h3]Boat Arena[/h3][p]Boat Arena had some major bugs and balancing issues. Here are some fixes:[/p][list][*][p]When the first train appears, the bigger arena will now spawn at the position of the previous arena.[/p][/*][*][p]The bigger arena (created by the train) has been remodelled to be chonkier and more stable[/p][/*][*][p]Luck Sign will now spawn objects at the arena position[/p][/*][/list][h3]Save crash[/h3][list][*][p]The save crash, blocking you from starting the game, because your save has been corrupted, should be fixed. The save should no longer be that easily corrupted. This won't retroactively fix old saves if they are corrupted; you still need to follow the procedure to delete your corrupted save: [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2902440/discussions/0/601911155312584934/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/2902440/discussions/0/601911155312584934/[/url][/p][/*][/list][h3]Other[/h3][list][*][p]Speed limit signs now display the two banned families even if you have not yet purchased them.[/p][/*][*][p]Some records were not saved when clicking on the "replay" button; this is now fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Various text improvements and fixes in different languages [/p][/*][*][p]Added the Japanese open-source font to the game credits[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Community[/h2][p]With this update, all major bugs should have been fixed. If you are met with a bug or unexpected behaviour, don't hesitate to report it to the Steam forum or the game Discord.[/p][p][/p][p]Do you want to do some fun tier list (here's some), share some artworks, funny moments, or help build a game wiki! Don't hesitate to join the game's Discord![/p][h3][url="https://discord.gg/XNDPDeYhxY" style="button"]Join the Discord community![/url][/h3][p][/p][p]Thank you,[/p][p]Steve[/p]

notes.title: New update - Balancing, new achievement, bug fixes...
notes.content:
[p]HELLO STEVE![/p][p]First and foremost, I would like to thank all the Steves and non-Steves for their amazing support! With only 4,700 wishlists pre-launch, we managed to sell more than 5,000 copies in under 5 days![/p][p]As definitely named Steve, I want to personally thank all of you for enjoying the game![/p][p][/p][h2]New content and new features[/h2][h3]New achievement[/h3][p]Added the "Stevie Wonder" achievement: Complete the warehouse. (translation to come to Russian and Chinese very soon)[/p][p][/p][h3]New shortcuts[/h3][p]Two new shortcuts have been added (keyboard only):[/p][p]F3 - Will disable the objects' tooltips[/p][p]F4 - Will hide the UI [/p][p][/p][p]In addition, a new shortcut has been added to both the  controller and the keyboard:[/p][p]Spacebar or Left Trigger will allow you to activate the buttons "End the round", "Access the shop", and "Next round"[/p][p][/p][h2]Balancing[/h2][h3]Passive changes[/h3][p][b]All sign[/b] weights have been slightly increased: from 0.5 density to 0.8. Except for the Forbidden passive[/p][p][b][i]Notes from Steve[/i][/b][i]: While the intent is that passive should be lighter than other objects, the weight was a bit too radical; with this new change, passive should fly a little less. 33 triangles should also be easier to achieve. Forbidden passive is an exception to the rule.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Bump Sign[/b] stats have changed; it now reads: Christmas Balls now give between [b]-25[/b] and 50 points. Instead of -35 beforehand.[/p][p][b][i]Notes from Steve[/i][/b][i]: The bump sign had a risk that was too big; while it was supposed to be a passive gamble, the stats should be in your favour.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Bowling Sign[/b] has been replaced by [b]Infinity Sign[/b] in the 33 triangle passive.[/p][p][/p][h3]Heart Whale[/h3][p]The heart whale has been changed to now give +2 hearts (instead of 1 heart) when eating a heart. With the Tree sign, the whale now gives +4 hearts instead of +2 hearts.[/p][p][b][i]Notes from Steve[/i][/b][i]: The heart whale seemed like the weakest of the bunch, not a "quest whale" with a big reward and not a great point value as well. The whale was also weaker than the Heart sign; with this change, the Heart Whale should open new opportunities for animals.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Sports balls  [/h3][p][b][i]Notes from Steve[/i][/b][i]: Sports balls are a bit too disruptive; while this is still the intent, they do not give a good enough reward. You can await more changes to sports balls soon, but those first changes should already help a bit.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Tennis Ball effect has been changed from "First wall: Create an asteroid" to [b]"First wall: Create a Mouse"
[i]Notes from Steve: [/i][/b][i]Tennis Ball was just unnecessary evil, this should lean more into a Sports balls - Animals - Fruits synergy[/i][/p][/*][*][p]First wall objects will now always spawn just above the sport ball.[/p][/*][*][p]Bowling ball area of destruction has been slightly increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Bowling ball will now also destroy maluses and other bowling bowls[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Other changes[/h2][list][*][p]Big Bang challenge now will have the two passives start in your deck instead of in the arena.[/p][p][b][i]Notes from Steve[/i][/b][i]: No more infinite reroll just for the passive to stay on board.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Blue wheel has been added to the warehouse to avoid confusion with Baby wheels.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "safeguard" saves, if your PC crashes while saving, you will be able to manually change your save with minor progression lost.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Text and typos[/h2][list][*][p]Typo fix for Bomb Whale[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Tree sign text to avoid confusion. Only the object eaten points are double[/p][/*][*][p]Update credits[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements are now translated into Russian (except Stevie Wonder)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Donuts are now correctly absorbed by Black hole.[/p][/*][*][p]Trains will now always appear at the center of the Arena to avoid them going through walls[/p][/*][*][p]Passives you start with in your challenges will no longer appear in your passive shop. This bug might have also affected the next game after your challenges.[/p][/*][*][p]Heart passive shop reduction should now always work[/p][/*][*][p]Sports letters weight has been half (from 40 density to 20), which should stop other objects from going through the arena[/p][/*][*][p]Changing the save file should now longer crash the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Passive shops are now longer yellow (in High) and have the correct shaders.[/p][/*][*][p]Lisa Simpson achievement should work better and count all fruits and objects eaten[/p][/*][*][p]Objects eaten and ladybugs absorbed now count in the end game "Number of destroyed objects" stats (new records incoming) [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Have a great day,[/p][p]Steve[/p]

notes.title: Release Patch Note - 1.0.0
notes.content: [p]Hello Steve's,[/p][p][/p][p]Here is the patch note for yesterday's update:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Day 1 patch:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a memory leak issue (you can now play for hours and hours, and the game will not get slower)[/p][/*][*][p]Add a small visual "-1 Heart" feedback when losing an object[/p][/*][*][p]Low-visual mode is more visually pleasing[/p][/*][*][p]You can now press "F5" to quickly start a new game (in the same arena and/or challenge)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Demo update:[/b][/p][p]Demo content has been reduced to accommodate the release of the game:[/p][list][*][p]Coin and Storage are no longer on the demo (Storage can still be unlocked by finishing the tutorial, but to play them, a full version will be required)[/p][/*][*][p]Mountain Arena has been removed from the demo[/p][/*][*][p]"Add to wishlist" button has been replaced by a "Purchase game" button[/p][/*][*][p]Switching between the demo and the full game no longer erases your arena progression[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Steve's note: The demo content was always a bit too generous from the start, with some players having played up to 100 hours in the demo! It did not feel right to lower the content before release, blocking people from playing. It now feels like the right time to adjust demo content while keeping it up and running![/i][/p][p][/p][p]Hope you are enjoying your warehouse![/p][p]Have a great day,[/p][p]Steve[/p]

notes.title: Small update - Passives rework and multiple saves
notes.content:
Hi Steve!
This small update is the last update before Steam Fest! At the menu today, making some passives more fun and multiples save system!

[h2]Passive changes[/h2]
[i][b]Comment from Steve:[/b] Some of the passives were not that fun to play or too bad. With this rework, the main idea is to have fruits a bit easier to play with a more combo-friendly passive (Passive of the sea) and globally make both Celestials and Fruits a bit easier to play[/i]

[b]Passive of the debris:[/b]
Old effect: Every Celestial generates 1-4 Asteroids when created
New effect: Every Celestial [b]gives twice more points[/b] when combining but generates 1-4 Asteroids when created

[b]Passive of the asteroid:[/b]
Old effect: When created, Black Hole generates 50 asteroids
New effect: When created, Black Hole generates [b]99[/b] asteroids

[b]Passive of the traffic light[/b]
Old effect: Deleters give incremental points
New effect: [b]Wheels[/b] can now be [b]destroyed for 3 deleters[/b]

[b]Passive of the sea:[/b]
Old effect: When a Whale is created, generate one of each fruit
New effect: When an [b]animal eats a fruit, generates [/b]either a cherry, a strawberry, a grape or an apple
[i]Comment from Steve: Passive of the sea + passive of the Snake = FUN[/i]

[h2]Multiple saves[/h2]
The game now has 3 save slots, by default (and your old save) is Save A but you can change save in the settings.
Also, there is a confirmation button if you want to delete your active save

notes.title: Challenges teaser and demo update: Stats!
notes.content:
Hi Steeeve,

On today's program, a new feature has been added to the full game, while the feature is not available in the demo, you deserve a small teaser!

[h1]Challenges![/h1]

The game will have 6 unique challenges at launch! Challenges will change the way to play the game entirely by altering the game system or offering unique situations that can't happen in a normal game!

notes.title: Demo update - Patch note v0.4.1
notes.content:
This update mainly focuses on balancing and improving the quality of life.

[h2]Major changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*][b] Whale effect changed[/b]: The whale now has 7 different effects including 4 available in the demo
[list]
[*] Black hole and Whale effect are unchanged 
[*] New effect: Eating heart for more lives!
[*] New effect: Eating coins for more gold!
[*] The passive effect has been improved and moved to the full game
[/list]
[*][b] Tooltips greatly improved[/b]: Text has been harmonized, fruits show which animal eats them, the text is now displayed on multiple lines, and important elements are in bold. Also, they can't go out of the screen. 
[*][b] Rarity draw changed[/b]: The rarity of the object shown in the shop will now increase with a round instead of being a fixed chance. This means you won't be able to find a 10-cost object. Detail:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032435/e29f0247e1b010efae717c05461b5361d0082d35.png[/img]
[*][b] Medal system reworked[/b]: Winning the game is not mandatory to unlock a medal, but only one medal can be unlocked per game. This affect a bit the demo by making the Capitalism medal easier to get.
[/list]

[h2]Balancing:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Coin only now gives 1 gold and is slightly bigger (visuals are incoming)
[*] The bike wheel is way bigger. (visuals are incoming) [i]Dev comment: The bike wheel was way too strong, and was a bit too game-breaking, while the item still allowed for game-breaking moments, it will become a bit more situational.[/i] 
[*] Fruits and Animals give more points
[*] Score has been harmonized between different families to follow a similar curve. Also, the information about the value of the families has been erased to not incentivize as much to play one family over another.
[*] Watermelon now gives 2 hearts
[*] Fruits values when eaten are a bit higher for lower fruits
[*] Black hole value changed: from 1/3/5/10/[b]40/100[/b]/500 to 1/3/5/10/[b]50/150[/b]/500
[*] Deleting all objects is not a strategy anymore, giving Red Wheels instead of Bike wheels and normal Wheels.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes and small improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Only one object will ever be deleted even if objects override each other. The game will now delete the object which is closer to the mouse
[*] Some typos in English and French.
[*] Tooltips will always be readable. Also, the time before they show up has been slightly increase +100ms
[*] An arrow has been added to the tutorial to showcase which (?) to hover
[*] Weird save/load bug has been erased
[*] Heart will become a counter if you have more than 8 hearts
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update: Save, New bosses, New visuals and more
notes.content:
Hi Steve,

This update has many changes, but first and foremost:

[h1]Save system[/h1]
The location of the save has been changed from :
[i]C:\Users\[YOURUSERNAME]\AppData\Local\UntitledSuikaLike[/i]
to
[i]C:\Users\[YOURUSERNAME]\AppData\Local\StevesWarehouse[/i]

This change was made to leave behind the temporary project name. You will have to move all files from one folder to the other manually.
Also, you can now play with different Steam accounts on the same computer and each player will have their save independently.

If you need help regarding this update, please contact us directly on the forum or [url=https://discord.gg/Df8rDa6bBE]Discord[/url].


[h2]Visual changes[/h2]
With this update, nearly all content from the demo is in a "close-to-finish" state, with this update, the heart, the ship, the wheel and the storage have new visuals!

The object now floats below the ship when played!
To celebrate all those changes, the game has a new trailer!

[previewyoutube=Rp7HusafdyE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


[h2]New bosses[/h2]
Each arena now has its bosses! You can now discover in the demo the boss for the Tutorial and the Mountain Arena

[h2]Demo page[/h2]
Today, we also release our Demo Steam page! If you liked the demo and would like to recommend it you can now do it directly on Steam:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2969070/Steves_Warehouse_Demo/]Steve's Warehouse Demo Page[/url]

[h2]Other changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] You start now the game with 3 golds
[*] All storage is a tiny bit bigger

[*] You can now take Steam screenshots with F12
[*] The first time you launch the game, the game will select your language depending on your Steam language, then you can override it by changing it in the settings
[*] 3 Aspect ratios are now available in the settings
[*] A fullscreen and borderless fullscreen are now available
[*] The noise visual effect is now below the objects
[*] The cost of items disappears when an object is bought
[*] Diverse UI improvements

[*] If you have no object on your deck at the end of a round the game will not crash anymore but you will have a new surprise

notes.title: Patch notes: Demo content changes, QoL improvments and Bug fixes!
notes.content:
Hi every-steves,

The demo just got updated!

[h2]Demo content[/h2]
[i]Thank you a lot to the nearly 1 000 players that already tested the Steve's Warehouse demo!
With that, I, Steve, got some data and some of you played... a ... lot! Which is pretty great but also way more than what I imagined, 100 of you played more than 3 hours of the demo, and more than 25 of you more than 5 hours!

This helped me notice, that the demo might be a bit too generous. I am showcasing a bit too many objects (more than 50% of the final objects) which feels a bit too much for only the demo. I would not want players to be disappointed when purchasing the full version because there is "not enough content" compared to the demo.[/i]

So here are some demo content adjustments:
Content leaving the demo :
[list]
[*] Discoballs family and their passives
[*] Christmas ball and their passives
[*] Bomb and their passives
[*] The dart and small wheels passive
[/list]

[i]Note: If you've already unlocked some of the content that leaves the demo, the content will still appear as unlocked but won't be able to be played with[/i]

[list]
[*] To showcase a bit more what the game has to offer, [b]a new difficulty has been added to the game![/b] Win a game in the cherry difficulty to be able to play in the Strawberry difficulty! 
[*] A new end-of-demo screen has also been added, it doesn't stop you from playing more, just remember to wishlist the game (Also please don't forget to wishlist the game ;)!
[/list]

[i]While I am lowering the demo content, having some of you test the game is still really useful to improve balancing and give new ideas! While the focus is currently on improving the demo, the playtest might be held in a few weeks or months, on the full game versions! If you want to be able to playtest the full game, don't hesitate to join [url=https://discord.gg/9pJNg8mkuh]our discord[/url].[/i]

[h2]Quality of life improvments[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Tooltips have been improved,[/b] they now only appear after 350ms of not moving on an object, and they also stop flicking between two objects
[*] Ship delimitation has been improved and is now more precise
[/list]

[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] Lowering the price of high-cost items, the price of items now is: 1/3/5/10
[*] Strawberry is now rare instead of common, Grape is no Epic instead of rare, Apple is now legendary instead of epic
[*] Blackhole is now smaller, to facilitate the possibility of creating high-value objects to be absorbed
[*] Passive are a bit heavier and will become a bit less jumpy
[*] Discoballs score calculation has changed and now gives the sum of the two disco balls value (not testable in the demo)
[*] E stop falling (big nerf I guess?)
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix the "unable to assign a collision category" bug, that was randomly crashing the game. I could not reproduce this bug, I am not 100% sure it is fixed, so don't hesitate to report it! The change I have made to fix this bug should also slightly improve the physics.
[*] Fix some typos (yes there are grapes)
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Updated! New passives, whale rework and visual update!
notes.content:
Hi fellow Steves,

The demo has been updated with a few changes:
[list]
[*] [b]Tutorial improved[/b], even if you don't read everything or do everything the tutorial will get less stuck and let you unlock the medal more easily. Also to give more to play early on, the Celestials family is not unlocked from the start and does not need to be unlocked!
[*] [b]Visuals improved[/b]! The visuals on the game are still "demo visuals" and will improve throughout the demo life before the release, thanks to our amazing artist Steve-Aglou! On this update, all fruits have been updated to be closer to their final looks
[*] [b]New passives[/b] that I will let you discover by yourself!! Also, the passive cost is no longer 7 golds but an increasing cost starting at 4 golds
[*] [b]Whale rework[/b], their effect has been kept for another last item family (transportation), they now have a unique effect each game! (out of 5 effects only 3 are playable in the demo)
[*] The [b]last family[/b] teased, while not playable in the demon, the last family has been added to the game, to watch their beautiful shadow in the Warehouse!
[*] Small score balancing on high-cost items (the high-level objects give a bit more points)
[*] Medals are a bit heavier to get less chance of flying out (unlike passive that should stay flying beast for now)
[*] A wishlist button has been added to the menu
[/list]


If you have any feedback, any bugs to report or want to learn more, don't hesitate to join our discord: https://discord.gg/9pJNg8mkuh
Thank you Steve,
Bye
Steve (i guess)
